key.name: github-token
key.description: A GitHub PAT with repo scope for querying PR and CI status via the GraphQL API.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to poll GitHub for updated PR CI status (60–3600).

key.name: notify-on-change
key.description: Show a desktop notification when a PR's CI status changes.

key.name: accepted-prs
key.description: JSON map of PR URL to {at, headOid}. Suppresses CI failures and unread comments for the accepted head commit until new activity (force-push, fresh failing check, or new comment) arrives.
